Create an open top box (220x300x160mm) with wall thickness of 8mm and bottom thickness of 12mm. | First, describe in words and step by step how the user's request can be implemented using function calls only. After the description, I will ask you to prepare the function call for execution, but don't execute it until I explicitly request it.

Step-by-step implementation concept (only with the provided functions).

1. Create the outer solid  
   • Use functions.block with one block that starts at the global origin (x=0, y=0, z=0).  
   • Dimensions = [220 mm, 300 mm, 160 mm] in X, Y, Z.  
   • subtraction = False (this establishes the initial volume).

2. Hollow the interior to obtain an open-top box  
   • Still in the same functions.block call (or in a second call) define a second block that will be removed.  
   • Inner cavity sizes:  
     – X-size = 220 − 2·8 = 204 mm  
     – Y-size = 300 − 2·8 = 284 mm  
     – Z-size = 160 − 12 = 148 mm (because the 12-mm-thick bottom stays in place)  
   • Basepoint of this cavity: (x=8, y=8, z=12). That leaves 8 mm wall thickness on all four sides and a 12 mm bottom.  
   • subtraction = True so this volume is carved out.

3. Seal the description  
   • Call functions.finished(allFunctionsCalled=True) to indicate that no more geometry commands follow.

When you are ready, ask me to prepare the exact function-call JSON payload; I will then supply it but will not execute it until you explicitly request execution.
